businesses.business: home healthcare equipment and medical supplies

offering_description.value: Provides home respiratory and sleep therapy equipment, durable medical equipment and chronic-condition medical supplies delivered directly to patients at home. Serves patients, referring clinicians and payers through branches, clinicians and delivery networks.

primary_products.value: home oxygen and respiratory equipment; sleep apnea devices (CPAP); durable medical equipment; diabetes, ostomy, urology and wound care supplies

primary_services.value: home respiratory therapy; sleep therapy management; patient delivery and setup; insurance billing and resupply; patient education

customer_segment.value: B2C: patients receiving care at home, often paid via insurance; B2B: commercial insurers and managed care payers, referring physicians and health systems; B2G: Medicare and Medicaid beneficiaries as government payers

end_markets.value: home healthcare; respiratory care; sleep medicine; diabetes and chronic disease management

revenue_model.value: healthcare reimbursement: payments from Medicare, Medicaid and private insurers for home equipment and supplies; rental or leasing: monthly rental of oxygen concentrators, ventilators and other equipment; product sales: recurring supplies such as diabetes, ostomy and urological products
revenue_model.category: healthcare reimbursement; rental or leasing; product sales

value_chain_position.value: service provider: home medical equipment provider delivering therapy and supplies to patients; distributor: buys medical supplies from manufacturers and ships directly to patients

geography_served.value: US national: Patients across the United States via branch and delivery network

specialization.value: related lines: home respiratory and durable equipment plus direct-to-patient chronic care medical supplies

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: referral-based direct delivery to patients' homes and mail shipment; own locations: branch locations serving local patients

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Medicare/Medicaid reimbursement rules, CMS competitive bidding, FDA device rules, state licensing, HIPAA

notes: Accendra Health is understood as the former Owens & Minor Patient Direct business (Apria, Byram); exact current scope is uncertain.
